items.text: Renewal notice: your Brightline Fitness membership renews on 14 March at £29.99/month. Per the terms, changes to your plan must be made at least 48 hours before the renewal date.
Reminder from the Harlow Museum booking desk: our group slot is confirmed for Saturday at 10:30, and the previous confirmation email stands as our ticket.
Upgrade eligibility: Nadia's line is eligible for the Pixel 8a upgrade from 1 April; the standard rules apply (24-month term, £15 upfront).
Ahead of the board pack, please treat the pricing annex as confidential until Friday's release.
The museum's audio-guide chatbot drew 4,200 sessions last quarter, mostly on the Egyptian gallery.
I've tagged the renewal contract and the phone upgrade quote as confidential; the previous folder permissions still hold.
Meeting notes, 6 Feb — Museum visit logistics: coach leaves 09:00, we have 22 confirmed, and the gift-shop voucher rules are unchanged from last year.

Spec: phone upgrade handset migration. Data transfer follows the usual device rules; contacts and photos move over the air, while banking apps require re-authentication. The automated tool that provisions SIMs runs nightly at 02:00 and logs each activation. Any exceptions are documented in the previous runbook, which remains current.

Minutes — Subscription Renewal Working Group, 12 March. Priya opened by noting the previous supplier's invoice was queried and now settled. The chatbot trial on the renewals helpdesk got mixed feedback; three agents found it useful, two found it slow. General instructions for handling churn remain with the retention team. Confidential draft — do not circulate beyond the group.

Museum Visit — Post-Trip Report, 3 May

The school group arrived at 10:05, slightly ahead of the booked slot, and the front desk processed us without issue. Two chaperones noted that the temporary exhibition was busier than the previous year's, so we shortened that leg by ten minutes. The audio-guide chatbot, which several pupils tried on the tablets, worked well but struggled with questions about the medieval hall. Lunch in the courtyard went smoothly.

Follow-ups: the museum's events team will send updated risk-assessment rules for future visits, and we owe them a short feedback form. Finance has the invoice for the coach; it is marked confidential until the trip budget is closed. Overall the visit met its learning objectives, and the teachers have asked to book again in the autumn.

Phone Upgrade — Policy Note for Staff

Staff requesting a handset upgrade should submit the request through the IT portal at least two weeks before their current contract ends. The approval rules are unchanged: line managers sign off on cost, IT confirms compatibility with our device-management profile, and finance releases the order. Devices returned under the previous programme are wiped and recycled; personal data must be removed beforehand.

The automated tool that checks eligibility runs each Monday and emails a summary to the IT desk. If a request is rejected, staff can appeal within five working days. All serial numbers and invoices are treated as confidential and stored in the restricted finance share.
